name: englishai-youtube-transcript-service
description: youtubei.js-backed YouTube transcript sidecar for EnglishAI.uz. The first link in the transcript fallback chain: it fetches a video's caption track via the InnerTube API the way the YouTube client does, returning timed English lines to the .NET orchestrator over HTTP. Stateless - it never stores a transcript (docs/development-guide.md: real-time only).
